statement: A local private company must, in respect of every year except the year of its incorporation, deliver an annual return in the specified form (Form NAR1) to the Registrar of Companies for registration within 42 days after the company's return date, which is the anniversary of the date of the company's incorporation in that year (Companies Ordinance section 662(1)-(2)).
caveat: Late delivery raises the registration fee on a published ladder (HK$870 within 3 months after the 42-day window, up to HK$3,480 past 9 months) and is an offence; public companies and guarantee companies file against financial-year-based return dates instead. Re-domiciled companies count from the anniversary of their re-domiciliation.
